task.title: Troubleshooting Amazon EC2
task.shortdesc: To troubleshoot Amazon EC2 builds in Red Hat Quay, you can identify the builder instance in the EC2 console and access it via SSH. Check the quay-builder service logs to diagnose build issues.

step.cmd: Start a Build in Red Hat Quay.
